classification_note: These classify evidence/readiness, not nine distinct implementation defects. Current backend status not reobserved retains historical ledger open but does not assert current missing implementation.

rows.existing_source_or_partial_capability: API26 NAPI and service/GAP/HCI OOB candidate exists, including real permission checks, single-use C/R, cancellation and real result propagation.
rows.remaining_requirement: Virtual-to-raw alias mapping, optional randomizer omission and actual local OOB generation are explicitly unavailable; actual controller/vendor/HDI and peer challenge remain required.
rows.evidence_limit: Actual source limitations are explicit; previous complete-TU/host passes do not prove a newly packaged controller/peer permission/off/data lifecycle.

rows.existing_source_or_partial_capability: Zero-or-one private IPC list, nullable disconnected state, calling-account scope, broker owner/generation and health candidate exist.
rows.remaining_requirement: Genuine CONNECTED TLS/TUN data, nullable/nonempty getters, permission/account and simultaneous-owner lifecycle on current new package.
rows.evidence_limit: Generic cleanup QA deliberately uses unreachable loopback and undefined getter, so it cannot close connected semantics.

rows.existing_source_or_partial_capability: Single/multi VPN bundle ownership, account filtering, 202/201 permission ordering and broker candidate exist.
rows.remaining_requirement: Real connected app list, no-ID/multi-ID owner/account boundaries, active packet path, death/reconnect and cleanup on new package.
rows.evidence_limit: Host/native/SDK passes are preparation; no current connected guest closure was found.

rows.existing_source_or_partial_capability: All three defconfigs have BPF_SYSCALL and CGROUP_BPF candidate.
rows.remaining_requirement: Actual new kernel BPF program/map load/attach, UID accounting, access-policy enforcement, denied caller and cleanup.
rows.evidence_limit: Historical ENOSYS is not a fresh observation on candidate kernel; configuration/source alone does not close backend.

rows.existing_source_or_partial_capability: Bluetooth enum/export and OOB source exist, but those do not establish controller availability.
rows.remaining_requirement: Select/confirm real controller+vendor/HDI, enable/disable final state, pairing/data/unplug/cleanup.
rows.evidence_limit: Baseline confirms old missing libbt_vendor rollback; no current packaged-controller observation was read. A missing modern backend is not freshly confirmed by this read-only audit.

rows.existing_source_or_partial_capability: Build stages mac80211_hwsim/virt_wifi; WPA scan/channel and real cfg80211 ACK/readback regulatory candidate exist.
rows.remaining_requirement: Current service identity/interface/modules; actual STA/AP association, DHCP/data/P2P, failures/device changes and teardown with compatible peer.
rows.evidence_limit: Old root diagnostic/regulatory candidate compile is not current production WiFi service/AP data proof.

rows.existing_source_or_partial_capability: Baseline ordinary USB service/root-hub enumeration exists.
rows.remaining_requirement: Actual host-device fixture/passthrough, device-mode UDC and configfs binding, MTP provider entry, descriptors/open/permission/data/unplug/cleanup.
rows.evidence_limit: Baseline missing UDC/MTP is unresolved. No current UDC/actual image observation was read; absence of local patches/common/base/usb alone is not proof the upstream implementation is missing.

rows.existing_source_or_partial_capability: Launcher still emits default user NAT; 267 supplies pure original-source-derived peer owner protocol.
rows.remaining_requirement: Explicit shared-network launcher/unique devices plus actual owned constructor guard/producer integration, discovery/account/authentication/distributed/cast traffic and removal.
rows.evidence_limit: 267 explicitly NOT_READY: actual constructor guard unimplemented and same-UID rule rejects macOS setuid ps. Passing synthetic protocol tests is not peer resource/guest proof.

rows.existing_source_or_partial_capability: Policy/store/getter/session/broker source candidates and limited generic cleanup QA exist.
rows.remaining_requirement: Explicit source gaps include persist-tun reconfiguration, unsupported split/encrypted/nonstandard-port DNS and nonzero route metric mapping; broad TLS/TUN/multi-owner/account/getter/options/dialog runtime proof remains.
rows.evidence_limit: 238 is fresh-input preparation only; 267 is NOT_READY; generic owned cleanup is narrower than full VPN finding. Existing source limitations cannot be reclassified as mere packaging.
